resources.string: Welcome to EARWAX\nA chrome head is your music player. Take a 30-second tour of the buttons.
Left ear\nPrevious, Play / Pause and Next. The ears vibrate with the bass while music plays.
Right ear\nLST: your library. EQ: 10-band equalizer. FX: pitch, speed, bass, treble, volume, sleep timer.
Forehead pearls\nS shuffle, R repeat, Z sleep timer, P floating popup window.
The screen\nDrag the bottom bar to seek. Swipe left or right for next / previous. Double-tap to play / pause. Tap the heart to favourite, ? to replay this tour.
Your library\nTabs: ALL, ALBUMS, ARTISTS, FAVS, RECENT, RADIO. Tap to play, long-press to favourite. RADIO streams internet stations: search, or paste a URL with + URL.
Floating popup\nPress P, drag it anywhere, pinch to resize, and circle your finger around the knob or dial to change volume, bass, pitch and more. The notification has a popup button too.
